dedupe_keys.name: hospitals r data package listing the 52 hospitals of the portuguese national health service

description: This small R data package lists the hospitals of Portugal's National Health Service (SNS). It was published on CRAN in November 2021 by Ramiro Magno, with the CINTESIS research centre as copyright holder and funder, and holds a single table of the then-current 52 hospitals, with the variables and data sources described in the package help. The package is free to install from CRAN, the source is available on GitHub under the nhs-pt organisation, and a citable version has a Zenodo DOI; the data are released under CC0, so they can be reused without conditions. Caveats: it is a 2021 snapshot that has not been updated, the SNS has since reorganised its hospitals into local health units, and the fields on the README are summarised only through the package help. Coverage is mainland Portugal and the islands as far as SNS hospitals go. Simulation uses: a ready facility list to join with bed, occupancy and emergency department statistics for hazard exposure or capacity studies of Portuguese hospitals. Related records: the SNS hospital beds and occupancy data (data-sns-portugal-hospital-beds-and-occupancy) and emergency department attendances (data-sns-portugal-emergency-department-attendances) give the activity figures.
